# pangolin_site (Resource)

Manages a Pangolin site (tunnel connector).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_site" "example" {
  name = "paris-01"
}

# Overrides the organization's newt_auto_update for this site only
# (enterprise). Leave it unset to follow the organization.
resource "pangolin_site" "pinned" {
  name                  = "lab-01"
  newt_auto_update      = false
  docker_socket_enabled = false
}

output "example_newt_id" {
  value = pangolin_site.example.newt_id
}

output "example_newt_secret" {
  value     = pangolin_site.example.newt_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the site.

### Optional

- `docker_socket_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Docker socket access on this site. Defaults to `true` to match the Pangolin API default.
- `newt_auto_update` (Boolean) Whether this site's Newt updates itself, overriding the organization's `newt_auto_update` (`pangolin_org`). Unset, the site follows the organization. Enterprise: a server without a license forces it off, so `true` fails with an inconsistent result.
- `rotation_disconnect` (Boolean) Whether a rotation disconnects the running Newt (default `true`). With `false` the tunnel stays up on its current session, and the old secret is only refused at the next reconnect: restart the connector with the new secret soon, since any reconnect (network loss, restart) before that fails.
- `rotation_trigger` (String) Arbitrary value that triggers a rotation of `newt_secret` whenever it changes (for example `"2026-11"`). On change, a new Newt secret is generated and `newt_secret` is updated in state. By default the new secret takes effect immediately: Pangolin disconnects the running tunnel and the old secret is rejected, so the connector stays down until it is restarted with the new secret (see `rotation_disconnect`). Changing it from unset to a value also rotates; removing it does not. Not read back from the API, so it is unset after `terraform import`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The WireGuard address of the site.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the site.
- `newt_id` (String) The Newt client ID assigned to this site. Set at creation time.
- `newt_secret` (String, Sensitive) The Newt client secret assigned to this site. Set at creation time and not retrievable from the API afterwards. Not available after `terraform import`.
- `nice_id` (String) The human-readable ID of the site.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the site is online.
- `type` (String) The type of the site (e.g. 'newt').

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Sites import by numeric ID. Look it up in the Pangolin web UI URL
# (e.g. /sites/4) or via the pangolin_sites data source.
#
# Note: `newt_secret` cannot be recovered from the Pangolin API after
# creation. After importing, it is set to null in state. Existing
# newt connectors keep working with their original secret; new ones
# bound to the imported site will need to be issued out-of-band.
terraform import pangolin_site.example <site_id>
```
